notes: V29 (CR 601.2f, 601.2h): with only {1}{G}, Titanic Growth can be cast at seat 0's own Bear but not at the opponent's Pursued Whale, whose tax makes the total {4}{G}. The Whale is not a live target (the slot drops it, so the cast is refused as an off-population target before anything is paid); the Bear cast then resolves (2/2 -> 6/6).
